title: POV: The 2 A.M. Gate

style_bible.character: One woman, about 30, olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, small gold hoops, slim build, natural minimal makeup.
style_bible.wardrobe: Oversized cream knit sweater, black travel pants and a matte black carry-on at the gate, then a plush white hotel robe at sunrise.
style_bible.setting: An empty, dim airport gate and concourse at night, then a minimal premium hotel room with a floor-to-ceiling window at sunrise.
style_bible.color_grade: Cool teal-blue desaturated night that flips to warm golden-amber morning, with soft contrast and clean blacks.
style_bible.lens_and_light: 35-50mm shallow depth of field with soft motivated light: phone glow and sodium overheads at night, low golden sun through the window in the morning.

scenes.description: Hook: tight on her exhausted face at a deserted gate. She lowers her phone and lets out a long exhale, and the carry-on stands at her feet.
scenes.camera: Handheld close-up with a slight POV sway, drifting down from her face to the carry-on.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, gold hoops: in a cream knit sweater, she lowers her phone and exhales, exhausted. Black carry-on at her feet, empty rows of seats at a dark airport gate at night, blurred runway lights in the window. Handheld close-up with a slight sway. Cool blue overheads, soft phone glow on her face with the screen angled away.

scenes.description: She glances back at the glowing phone, then her brow relaxes, her shoulders drop and a relieved smile spreads across her face.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in from medium close-up to close-up, steadier than shot 1.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, gold hoops: in a cream knit sweater, seated at an empty night gate, she looks at the glowing phone and her tense face softens into a relieved smile as her shoulders drop. Phone screen faces away and is out of focus. Slow push-in from medium close-up to close-up. Cool blue ambient light warmed by the phone glow.

scenes.description: She stands and walks away down the empty concourse with her carry-on rolling behind her, calm and unhurried.
scenes.camera: Low-angle tracking shot from behind, gliding smoothly at her pace.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, gold hoops: in a cream knit sweater, she walks calmly away down an empty, polished airport concourse at night, pulling a black carry-on. Reflective floor with soft pools of light. Smooth low-angle tracking shot from behind. Cool blue light shifting slightly warmer ahead of her.

scenes.description: Payoff: in a white hotel robe by a sunlit window, she holds a coffee mug, takes in the view and smiles with quiet confidence. Bright sky fills the upper third.
scenes.camera: Locked-off medium shot with a gentle slow push-in, framed low to leave clean sky above.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, gold hoops: in a plush white hotel robe, she stands by a floor-to-ceiling window holding a white coffee mug and smiles calmly at a city skyline at sunrise. Minimal premium hotel room. Medium shot framed low, bright empty sky in the upper third, gentle slow push-in. Warm golden backlight with a soft glow on her face.

sound: Shots 1-3: faint airport room tone, a distant PA hum and a soft tired exhale, with a single low muted piano note under the hook. As she smiles, a warm minimal synth-and-piano bed swells. Shot 4: gentle morning ambience with a faint coffee sip and soft birdsong, and the music resolves warmly into the end card.
